narrative: Seventh round on L9 (final level of bp35), continuation of round 18. No win; frontier stays at level 8. The headline result is a CORRECTION of round 18 plus a new capability. (1) NEW TOOL: the env's f.frame is a multi-LAYER animation array (e.g. 57 layers for the fatal fall) captured with a FIXED camera during a single action, so it reveals the player's ABSOLUTE vertical trajectory (up vs down) directly -- a real advance over the camera-relative single settled-frame reading used in rounds 13-18 (where the camera re-centers on the player every step and hides absolute motion). Built scratchpad tooling (bp35_l9_traj.py) that reads the player's row-path from these layers. (2) CORRECTION OF ROUND 18: using this tool, the door-shaft LEFT death is NOT a pillar eye. Opening the leftmost door (cols13-17, the goal's own columns) and sliding LEFT sends the player into the shaft at cols15-16 and the player RISES (row 37 -> 0 across the animation, passing row20 unharmed), then flies off the OPEN top of the shaft (the door-open also removed the ceiling at cols13-17 rows0) and dies at row0. Verified 3x (player row path min=0, max=37). Round 18's 'pillar eye at cols14-16 row20' was an artifact of reading the static overview; it is retracted. The shaft goes UP, AWAY from the goal (which is below), so it is not the intended descent. (3) Flipping to UP-gravity BEFORE entering the shaft (open door + LEFT + flip {x:3,y:27} + LEFT) SURVIVES the fly-off but merely returns the player to the up-gravity pocket at cols15-16 row27 -- no goal, no descent. (4) NO DESCENT EXISTS from the fall-through landing: trajectory analysis of every move (LEFT/RIGHT) and every click (pillars, switches, doors) shows the player stays at the same absolute level (flat) or rises; none produce a downward trajectory toward the goal. (5) REFINEMENT OF ROUND 18's toggle-block claim: color-12 toggle blocks appear in ZERO cells across EVERY live reachable state tested (start, flip-up, fall-through landing, +1 door, +3 doors, +flip-up, corridor). They ONLY appear in the GAME_OVER overview frame. So they are NOT a live-usable mechanism -- likely an overview-only render, not interactable in play; round 18 overstated their usefulness. NET: the goal remains topologically SEALED (reachable only via the walled-off cols0-5 pocket per round 18's still-valid wall analysis); the two candidate descents (door shaft, pillar gap) both go elsewhere (up, and to the fall-through room respectively); no reachable action descends to the goal. No new level banked; frontier stays at level 8.
